name: Sunclass (2019)
description: White all over. The fin white with two wavy ribbons across it: an orange one from the trailing edge high up that bends down and forward, turning yellow as it narrows and reaching the leading edge low down, and a yellow one from the trailing edge low down that ends in a curve mid-fin. A broad orange swoosh round the rear fuselage under the fin, from the crown ahead of the fin down and aft to below the window line, ending in a point under the tailplane. 'SUNCLASS' in orange inline capitals (each stroke two thin lines) over the forward windows with two small waves after it. White engines, orange sharklets.

areas.name: orange swoosh round the rear fuselage
yellow lower-forward part of the upper ribbon

titles.style: Geometric capitals drawn inline, each stroke two thin orange lines with white between, round S, U and C, a pointed A; two small waves after the last S at cap height; over the forward windows, the windows running through it. Reads normally on both sides.

notes: The fin's ribbons and the swoosh were probed point by point off OY-TCF (a right side, flipped), so the right side is measured and the left follows by the mirror, which OY-TCE (left, from below) agrees with. The orange's change to yellow in the upper ribbon is drawn as a sharp line at its narrowest; in photos it changes there quickly. Colours: OY-TCD in sun; the evening photo of OY-TCF reads redder. The title's waves sit after the last S in reading order, so forward on the right side and aft on the left. Not drawn: the registration on the swoosh (white), small flags.
history: Sunclass Airlines is the former Thomas Cook Airlines Scandinavia, renamed in 2019 when Thomas Cook failed; its A321s and A330s were repainted from the Thomas Cook heart scheme into this one.
